33: def grab(
34:     bbox: tuple[int, int, int, int] | None = None,
35:     include_layered_windows: bool = False,
36:     all_screens: bool = False,
37:     xdisplay: str | None = None,
38:     window: int | ImageWin.HWND | None = None,
39:     *,
40:     scale_down: bool = False,
41: ) -> Image.Image:
42:     im: Image.Image
43:     if xdisplay is None:
44:         if sys.platform == "darwin":
45:             fh, filepath = tempfile.mkstemp(".png")
46:             os.close(fh)
47:             args = ["screencapture"]
48:             if window is not None:
49:                 args += ["-l", str(window)]
50:             elif bbox:
51:                 left, top, right, bottom = bbox
52:                 args += ["-R", f"{left},{top},{right-left},{bottom-top}"]
53:             args += ["-x", filepath]
54:             retcode = subprocess.call(args)
55:             if retcode:
56:                 raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(retcode, args)
57:             im = Image.open(filepath)
58:             im.load()
59:             os.unlink(filepath)
60:             if bbox:
61:                 if window is not None:
62:                     # Determine if the window was in Retina mode or not
63:                     # by capturing it without the shadow,
64:                     # and checking how different the width is
65:                     fh, filepath = tempfile.mkstemp(".png")
66:                     os.close(fh)
67:                     args = ["screencapture", "-l", str(window), "-o", "-x", filepath]
68:                     retcode = subprocess.call(args)
69:                     if retcode:
70:                         raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(retcode, args)
71:                     with Image.open(filepath) as im_no_shadow:
72:                         retina = im.width - im_no_shadow.width > 100
73:                     os.unlink(filepath)
74: 
75:                     # Since screencapture's -R does not work with -l,
76:                     # crop the image manually
77:                     if retina:
78:                         left, top, right, bottom = bbox
79:                         scale = 1 if scale_down else 2
80:                         im_cropped = im.resize(
81:                             ((right - left) * scale, (bottom - top) * scale),
82:                             box=tuple(coord * 2 for coord in bbox),
83:                         )
84:                     else:
85:                         im_cropped = im.crop(bbox)
86:                     im.close()
87:                     return im_cropped
88:                 elif scale_down:
89:                     im_resized = im.resize((right - left, bottom - top))
90:                     im.close()
91:                     return im_resized
92:             return im
93:         elif sys.platform == "win32":
94:             if window is not None:
95:                 all_screens = -1
96:             offset, size, data = Image.core.grabscreen_win32(
97:                 include_layered_windows,
98:                 all_screens,
99:                 int(window) if window is not None else 0,
100:             )
101:             im = Image.frombytes(
102:                 "RGB",
103:                 size,
104:                 data,
105:                 # RGB, 32-bit line padding, origin lower left corner
106:                 "raw",
107:                 "BGR",
108:                 (size[0] * 3 + 3) & -4,
109:                 -1,
110:             )
111:             if bbox:
112:                 x0, y0 = offset
113:                 left, top, right, bottom = bbox
114:                 im = im.crop((left - x0, top - y0, right - x0, bottom - y0))
115:             return im
116:     # Cast to Optional[str] needed for Windows and macOS.
117:     display_name: str | None = xdisplay
118:     try:
119:         if not Image.core.HAVE_XCB:
120:             msg = "Pillow was built without XCB support"
121:             raise OSError(msg)
122:         size, data = Image.core.grabscreen_x11(display_name)
123:     except OSError:
124:         if display_name is None and sys.platform not in ("darwin", "win32"):
125:             if shutil.which("gnome-screenshot"):
126:                 args = ["gnome-screenshot", "-f"]
127:             elif shutil.which("grim"):
128:                 args = ["grim"]
129:             elif shutil.which("spectacle"):
130:                 args = ["spectacle", "-n", "-b", "-f", "-o"]
131:             else:
132:                 raise
133:             fh, filepath = tempfile.mkstemp(".png")
134:             os.close(fh)
135:             args.append(filepath)
136:             retcode = subprocess.call(args)
137:             if retcode:
138:                 raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(retcode, args)
139:             im = Image.open(filepath)
140:             im.load()
141:             os.unlink(filepath)
142:             if bbox:
143:                 im_cropped = im.crop(bbox)
144:                 im.close()
145:                 return im_cropped
146:             return im
147:         else:
148:             raise
149:     else:
150:         im = Image.frombytes("RGB", size, data, "raw", "BGRX", size[0] * 4, 1)
151:         if bbox:
152:             im = im.crop(bbox)
153:         return im

156: def grabclipboard() -> Image.Image | list[str] | None:
157:     if sys.platform == "darwin":
158:         p = subprocess.run(
159:             ["osascript", "-e", "get the clipboard as «class PNGf»"],
160:             capture_output=True,
161:         )
162:         if p.returncode != 0:
163:             return None
164: 
165:         import binascii
166: 
167:         data = io.BytesIO(binascii.unhexlify(p.stdout[11:-3]))
168:         return Image.open(data)
169:     elif sys.platform == "win32":
170:         fmt, data = Image.core.grabclipboard_win32()
171:         if fmt == "file":  # CF_HDROP
172:             import struct
173: 
174:             o = struct.unpack_from("I", data)[0]
175:             if data[16] == 0:
176:                 files = data[o:].decode("mbcs").split("\0")
177:             else:
178:                 files = data[o:].decode("utf-16le").split("\0")
179:             return files[: files.index("")]
180:         if isinstance(data, bytes):
181:             data = io.BytesIO(data)
182:             if fmt == "png":
183:                 from . import PngImagePlugin
184: 
185:                 return PngImagePlugin.PngImageFile(data)
186:             elif fmt == "DIB":
187:                 from . import BmpImagePlugin
188: 
189:                 return BmpImagePlugin.DibImageFile(data)
190:         return None
191:     else:
192:         if os.getenv("WAYLAND_DISPLAY"):
193:             session_type = "wayland"
194:         elif os.getenv("DISPLAY"):
195:             session_type = "x11"
196:         else:  # Session type check failed
197:             session_type = None
198: 
199:         if shutil.which("wl-paste") and session_type in ("wayland", None):
200:             args = ["wl-paste", "-t", "image"]
201:         elif shutil.which("xclip") and session_type in ("x11", None):
202:             args = ["xclip", "-selection", "clipboard", "-t", "image/png", "-o"]
203:         else:
204:             msg = "wl-paste or xclip is required for ImageGrab.grabclipboard() on Linux"
205:             raise NotImplementedError(msg)
206: 
207:         p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True)
208:         if p.returncode != 0:
209:             err = p.stderr
210:             for silent_error in [
211:                 # wl-paste, when the clipboard is empty
212:                 b"Nothing is copied",
213:                 # Ubuntu/Debian wl-paste, when the clipboard is empty
214:                 b"No selection",
215:                 # Ubuntu/Debian wl-paste, when an image isn't available
216:                 b"No suitable type of content copied",
217:                 # wl-paste or Ubuntu/Debian xclip, when an image isn't available
218:                 b" not available",
219:                 # xclip, when an image isn't available
220:                 b"cannot convert ",
221:                 # xclip, when the clipboard isn't initialized
222:                 b"xclip: Error: There is no owner for the ",
223:             ]:
224:                 if silent_error in err:
225:                     return None
226:             msg = f"{args[0]} error"
227:             if err:
228:                 msg += f": {err.strip().decode()}"
229:             raise ChildProcessError(msg)
230: 
231:         data = io.BytesIO(p.stdout)
232:         im = Image.open(data)
233:         im.load()
234:         return im

41:         a positive integer to append it.
